rows.name: protected_copper_preserved
rows.why: all 235 segment(s) on ANT_FEED, NFC1, NFC2 came back, each within 55 nm of where it was sent — under the 100 nm the format can carry (halo_rev_a.ses: (resolution um 10) = one step is 0.0001 mm). 25 segment(s) ADDED on those nets ({'ANT_FEED': 9, 'NFC2': 16}) — the router extending a protected net to reach its pads, which is routing, not rerouting

rows.name: protected_length_preserved
rows.why: the matched conductor is 162.2257 mm going out and 162.2258 mm coming back, a difference of 169 nm against a quantisation budget of 47000 nm (two grid steps per segment). The NFC coil's inductance and the element's resonance are both functions of this length
